name: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords is a singleplayer third-person role-playing game and the second in the Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic series.

eax.problem: The original release used DirectSound3D, but a later patch replaced it with a newer audio engine that dropped EAX entirely.
eax.fix: Steam beta branch 'legacypc' reverts to the pre-patch build with EAX intact (right-click the game -> Properties -> Betas).
